annotation.title_en: National Artificial Intelligence Action Plan for Thailand Development, 6-Year Period (2022–2027)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation; Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (Thailand)
annotation.summary_en: Thailand's six-year national AI action plan (2022–2027) from the digital and higher education ministries. It sets a vision of an integrated AI ecosystem and lays out strategies on AI ethics, law and regulation, infrastructure, talent, research and industrial adoption. Robotics appears only incidentally, for example in research funding programmes.
key_provisions_or_claims: Vision: an integrated AI ecosystem by 2027 to raise the economy and quality of life
Strategy 1 prepares society, ethics, law and regulation for AI, including governance guidelines and an enforcing body
Strategy 2 builds digital and data infrastructure and national AI and data platforms
Calls for AI Centers of Excellence and more investment in AI research and AI ethics research
Reviews AI strategies of the EU and 27 other countries to benchmark Thailand
